prompts.title: Website
prompts.summary: An open website brief: the model invents the subject, brand, content and visual direction of a complete site.
prompts.requirement: Original concept and identity; substantial real content; responsive layout; working interactions; accessible and fast

prompts.title: Production Site Refresh
prompts.summary: A fixed source: refresh the live Shutterhaus Visuals production site — same doctrine, a generation better, shipped as one self-contained static folder.
prompts.requirement: All five public pages rebuilt; keyboard gallery and scroll frames preserved; zero third-party requests; no build step; content in the markup; WCAG 2.2 AA; verified performance budget

prompts.title: Restaurant Website
prompts.summary: A restaurant or cafe website with a full menu, reservations and a distinctive art direction.
prompts.requirement: Real menu with 30+ items; reservation and order flows with validation; opening-hours logic; strong identity; responsive and accessible

prompts.title: Editorial Website
prompts.summary: A complete editorial publication with a distinctive identity, substantial content and a considered multi-page reading experience.
prompts.requirement: Semantic HTML; sophisticated CSS layout and typography; homepage plus two content pages; responsive navigation; accessible and polished

prompts.title: CSS Interactive Experience
prompts.summary: An original interactive browser experience built with HTML and advanced CSS, without JavaScript.
prompts.requirement: CSS-only interaction and animation; advanced layout and custom properties; responsive states; reduced-motion support; accessible native controls

prompts.title: Design System
prompts.summary: A complete reusable design system with tokens, components, variants and a showcase of the system in use.
prompts.requirement: Semantic HTML and CSS; coherent design tokens; reusable components; interaction states; responsive showcase; accessible component patterns

prompts.title: JavaScript Application
prompts.summary: A complete browser application built with vanilla JavaScript, meaningful workflows and persistent user data.
prompts.requirement: Vanilla JavaScript; real state and data management; multiple views; validation and error handling; persistence; import/export where relevant

prompts.title: Three.js 3D Experience
prompts.summary: An original interactive 3D browser experience built around a real Three.js scene.
prompts.requirement: Three.js rendering; geometry, materials and lighting; camera and scene interaction; animation; responsive controls; performance and WebGL fallback

prompts.title: SVG Drawing Studio
prompts.summary: A browser-based vector drawing studio where users create, select, transform and export real SVG artwork.
prompts.requirement: SVG-first rendering; editable shapes and paths; selection and transforms; fill and stroke controls; undo/redo; SVG export; pointer and keyboard support

prompts.title: Creative Tool
prompts.summary: A professional-grade creative tool in the browser: layered, non-destructive, fast and dense enough for real work.
prompts.requirement: Real file open and export; layered non-destructive workflow with undo/redo; eight or more tools; autosave; smooth zoom and pan on large canvases

prompts.title: Generative Art
prompts.summary: A seeded generative artwork that evolves in real time and is worth watching rather than a screensaver.
prompts.requirement: Deterministic seeding from the URL; three or more scenes or developments; collaborative interaction; high-resolution PNG export; adaptive resolution

prompts.title: Browser Operating System
prompts.summary: A complete desktop operating system in the browser with its own identity, window management and a shared filesystem.
prompts.requirement: Window manager with snap and z-order; persisted shared filesystem; eight or more apps including a terminal and editor; launcher search; persistent settings

prompts.title: Data Story
prompts.summary: An interactive data-driven story built on a generated dataset, told through linked custom visualisations.
prompts.requirement: Four or more hand-built visual forms with linked interaction; a genuine insight with a narrative arc; annotations, tooltips and CSV export; responsive redraw
